title.narrative: Accelerating green financial flows in the Northern Mexican Border

description.narrative: Mobilize sustainable financing in the Northern states of Mexico to reduce CO2 emissions and increase people’s resilience through enhanced environmental infrastructure financed by NADB.

Provide technical assistance on green finance, including enabling conditions and project/portfolio structuring,in the northern states of Mexico, by supporting the North American Development Bank (NADB) in developing bond/financing frameworks for NADB and two subnational states, 1 climate smart PPP, 1 smart cities plan, 1 toolkit/userguide to operationalize Green Loan Framework (developed under MX17) and capacity building for financial intermediaries and subnational states in Sustainble Finance/Green Loan Framework. This project will add up to current work on MX34 (GCF Readiness Programme) that aims NADB'as accrediation and concept note development.
